title: JSDF Type 20 Rifle Section
description: Precision rifle section: 450 range, fast armour-piercing bullets, 210 ammunition, all-rank fire. Native Rapid Volley provides a temporary reload boost.
long_description: Supported-mechanics Type 20 upgrade. Preserves the user-confirmed two-shot firing cycle and native reload handling. Accuracy 80; bullet velocity field 850; spaced two-rank formation; skirmish retreat disabled and guard capability enabled. Rapid Volley uses native 60s duration / 300s recharge / 60s initial recharge. Optional Suppression Fire module: native 30s / 120s with damaging suppressive ammunition; its shared ability definition also affects other native Suppression Fire users. Five-round bursts, per-soldier magazine reloads and true full-auto are not implemented. Tosa/Spencer visuals remain placeholders.
